plan.coverage_notes: Plan uses Pattern C throughout with a 9-synonym adolescent depression anchor to maintain precision while maximizing recall. Queries cover the full range the profile specifies: psychotherapies (CBT, IPT-A, BA, mindfulness), pharmacotherapy (SSRIs, combination), family-based treatments, digital/app interventions, assessment tools, suicide risk, social media links, school prevention, comorbid anxiety, implementation science, and effect-size/meta-analysis evidence. Queries deliberately exclude neuroimaging, biomarkers, and developmental neuroscience per the profile. The 12-query plan should return an estimated 800–1200 unique papers across the week, sufficient for the ranker to identify highly relevant clinical papers while maintaining coverage across all specified treatment modalities and clinical concerns.
